applies_to: Public & private organizations (incl. foreign firms targeting Paraguay)
key_requirements: Consent & lawful basis, data subject rights, security & transparency duties
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data; children's data
retention_period: Art. 4 principles incl. storage-period limitation: keep data only as long as necessary for processing purposes; deadlines may be set by the authority
enforcement_authority: National Personal Data Protection Agency (Agencia Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales) under MITIC
penalties_range: Up to 10,000 minimum daily wages (jornales mínimos)
exemptions: Personal/household use; defence, security & criminal investigation
genetic_data: Genetic data defined in the law (inherited or acquired genetic characteristics) and classed as sensitive data
notes: Enacted; main obligations apply 24 months after publication (Nov 2027); regulations pending
